title: Observability ingestion delay and query failures

timeline.body: Cloudflare has identified an issue impacting Observability ingestion and querying. Customers may be seeing delays in new data coming in and increased error rates querying Workers Observability and Cloudflare Traces data. We are working to analyze and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
